summary: Admin panel for managing orders, with added promo code management for website checkout and promo usage tracking on orders.
architectural_notes: Orders should persist promo metadata: promoApplied (boolean) and promoCodeUsed (string/code id) to display in admin orders list/detail.

existing_features.title: Add a new Promo Codes section in the admin panel UI where admins can add and remove (or deactivate) promo codes, and view the current list of configured promo codes.
Update the checkout/order creation UI to allow users to enter an optional promo code, apply a 5% discount when the promo code is valid, and submit the promo code with the order creation request.
Display promo usage on order views in the admin panel so admins can see whether a promo was used and which code was applied for each order.
Add React Query hooks and query keys for promo code admin operations (list/add/remove or deactivate) and ensure relevant queries are invalidated/refetched after mutations.

new_feature_requests.summary: Add admin panel section to create/manage promo codes (5% off) usable at website checkout; store on each order whether a promo was used and which code.
Extend the backend order model to record promo usage per order, including whether a promo code was applied and which promo code string was used.

Add backend admin APIs to manage promo codes that provide a 5% discount, including: list promo codes, add a promo code, and remove (or deactivate) a promo code. Promo code management must be restricted to admins.

Update backend order creation to accept an optional promo code, validate it against the promo codes configured by admins, and store the promo code used on the order when valid. Invalid promo codes must not be accepted for discount application.

projectName: Add admin-managed promo codes (5% off) and promo usage tracking on orders
